headline: Saturday in Branson: cool fall days, steady lake bite, and evening lights
lede: Saturday, October 24 brings cool crisp air with highs in the upper 20s (F), low rain chance, and excellent conditions for first-timers to enjoy the lake and shows. Layers recommended for morning and evening.

featured.title: Evening at the Branson Landing
featured.why: Fountain shows, live music, lights, and waterfront dining to cap a perfect fall Saturday

plan.title: Table Rock morning fishing
plan.detail: Cool water temps favor topwater and jig bites for bass and crappie on main lake points. Steady reports from recent scouts.

plan.title: Explore 76 Country Music Boulevard
plan.detail: Visit shows, dining, or Taneycomo for trout fishing below the dam. Comfortable temps for walking the Strip.

plan.title: Branson Landing lights and shows
plan.detail: Catch an evening performance then stroll the waterfront for fountain show and dinner with a view.
